title: Journal Prompt Completion Rate
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=journal:entry prompted=true
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as completed, dc(prompt_id) as prompt_variety by _time
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how consistently you complete prompted journal entries instead of skipping reflective moments.
value: Prompt completion is a simple measure of self-reflection consistency and can show when a journaling habit is quietly fading.
implementation: Tag prompted entries in `index=personal`; summarize weekly completion counts and prompt variety.
visualization: Weekly column chart of completed prompts with a secondary value for variety.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how often you actually answer your journaling prompts, so a reflective habit does not quietly disappear.
